WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(CAST(ANA AS REAL)) as A
  FROM Examination
  WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(A) as B
  FROM patient_avgs
)
SELECT 
  patient_avgs.ID,
  patient_avgs.A,
  patient_avgs.A - overall_avg.B as diff
FROM patient_avgs, overall_avg
WHERE patient_avgs.A > overall_avg.B
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN (patient_avgs.A - overall_avg.B) IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  (patient_avgs.A - overall_avg.B) DESC
LIMIT 10
